require 'sinatra'
require 'securerandom'
require 'fileutils'
require 'json'
require 'digest'

module UploadService
  UPLOAD_DIR = '/var/www/uploads'
  STATIC_DIR = '/var/www/html/static'
  ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = %w[.txt .html .htm .css .js .json .xml].freeze
  MAX_FILE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024

  class ContentPolicy
    DANGEROUS_PATTERNS = [
      /<!--\s*#\s*exec/i,
      /<!--\s*#\s*include/i,
      /<!--\s*#\s*echo/i,
      /<!--\s*#\s*config/i,
      /<!--\s*#\s*fsize/i,
      /<!--\s*#\s*flastmod/i,
      /<!--\s*#\s*printenv/i,
      /<!--\s*#\s*set/i
    ].freeze

    def self.scan(content)
      DANGEROUS_PATTERNS.each do |pattern|
        return false if content.match?(pattern)
      end
      true
    end
  end

  class FileProcessor
    def initialize(upload_dir, static_dir)
      @upload_dir = upload_dir
      @static_dir = static_dir
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(@upload_dir)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(@static_dir)
    end

    def process(filename, content, metadata = {})
      ext = File.extname(filename).downcase
      unless ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.include?(ext)
        return { error: 'File type not allowed', status: 403 }
      end

      if content.bytesize > MAX_FILE_SIZE
        return { error: 'File too large', status: 413 }
      end

      safe_name = sanitize_filename(filename)
      staged_path = File.join(@upload_dir, safe_name)

      File.write(staged_path, content)

      if needs_processing?(ext)
        processed = apply_transforms(staged_path, content, metadata)
        publish(safe_name, processed)
      else
        publish(safe_name, content)
      end

      { path: "/static/#{safe_name}", status: 201 }
    end

    private

    def sanitize_filename(name)
      base = File.basename(name)
      base.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/, '_')
    end

    def needs_processing?(ext)
      %w[.html .htm].include?(ext)
    end

    def apply_transforms(path, content, metadata)
      content = normalize_encoding(content)
      content = strip_dangerous_content(content)
      content = inject_metadata_headers(content, metadata)
      content = final_validation(content)
      content
    end

    def normalize_encoding(content)
      content.encode('UTF-8', invalid: :replace, undef: :replace, replace: '')
    end

    def inject_metadata_headers(content, metadata)
      return content if metadata.empty?

      header_comment = build_header(metadata)
      if content.include?('<head>')
        content.sub('<head>', "<head>\n#{header_comment}")
      else
        "#{header_comment}\n#{content}"
      end
    end

    def build_header(metadata)
      lines = ["<!-- Upload Metadata"]
      metadata.each do |key, value|
        sanitized_key = key.to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/, '')
        sanitized_value = strip_ssi_entirely(value.to_s)
        lines << "  #{sanitized_key}: #{sanitized_value}"
      end
      lines << "-->"
      lines.join("\n")
    end

    def strip_ssi_entirely(str)
      str.gsub('<', '<').gsub('>', '>').gsub('-', '-')
    end

    def strip_dangerous_content(content)
      ContentPolicy::DANGEROUS_PATTERNS.each do |pattern|
        content = content.gsub(pattern) { '<!-- [REMOVED] ' }
      end
      content = content.gsub(/<!--[^>]*#[^>]*-->/) { |m|
        if m =~ /<!--\s*#/i
          '<!-- [REMOVED] -->'
        else
          m
        end
      }
      content
    end

    def final_validation(content)
      unless ContentPolicy.scan(content)
        raise SecurityError, "Content failed final security validation after processing"
      end
      content
    end

    def publish(name, content)
      dest = File.join(@static_dir, name)
      File.write(dest, content)
    end
  end
end

processor = UploadService::FileProcessor.new(
  UploadService::UPLOAD_DIR,
  UploadService::STATIC_DIR
)

post '/upload' do
  content_type :json

  unless params[:file] && params[:file][:tempfile]
    halt 400, { error: 'No file provided' }.to_json
  end

  file = params[:file]
  filename = file[:filename]
  content = file[:tempfile].read

  metadata = {}
  metadata['uploaded_by'] = params[:username] if params[:username]
  metadata['description'] = params[:description] if params[:description]
  metadata['timestamp'] = Time.now.utc.iso8601

  begin
    result = processor.process(filename, content, metadata)
    status result[:status]
    result.to_json
  rescue SecurityError => e
    status 403
    { error: e.message }.to_json
  end
end

get '/health' do
  content_type :json
  { status: 'ok' }.to_json
end
